def card(task, wd):
    H, W, fps = (90, 160, 30)
    fields = []
    for k in range(6):
        n = 0.65 * _blur(np.random.default_rng(100 + k).random((H, W)), 0.6) + 0.35 * _blur(np.random.default_rng(200 + k).random((H, W)), 1.2)
        fields.append((n - n.min()) / (n.max() - n.min()))
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[:H, :W]
    r = np.hypot((xx - W / 2) / (W / 2), (yy - H / 2) / (H / 2)) / math.sqrt(2)
    vig = 1 - 0.42 * _smoothstep(0.55, 1, r)
    base = np.full((H, W), 205 / 255)

    def soft_light(b, s):
        d = np.where(b <= 0.25, ((16 * b - 12) * b + 4) * b, np.sqrt(b))
        return np.where(s <= 0.5, b - (1 - 2 * s) * b * (1 - b), b + (2 * s - 1) * (d - b))

    def frame(t, grain=True):
        k = int(math.floor(t / 0.1 + 1e-09)) % 6
        g = fields[k] if grain else np.full((H, W), 0.5)
        c = base * (1 - 0.09) + soft_light(base, g) * 0.09
        return np.stack([c * vig * 255] * 3, -1)
    n = 36
    vid = _video(wd / 'grain_stepped.mp4', [frame(i / fps) for i in range(n)], fps)
    v = fx.frames(vid, (W, H))
    changes = [i for i in range(1, n) if np.abs(v[i] - v[i - 1]).max() > 0]
    exp_changes = [i for i in range(1, n) if int(math.floor(i / fps / 0.1 + 1e-09)) != int(math.floor((i - 1) / fps / 0.1 + 1e-09))]
    loop = float(np.abs(v[0] - v[18]).max())
    grey = float(np.abs(v[5][..., 0] - v[5][..., 2]).max())
    corner, centre = (float(v[0][:6, :6, 0].mean()), float(v[0][40:50, 75:85, 0].mean()))
    plate = [frame(i / fps, False) for i in range(6)]
    plate_changes = sum((np.abs(plate[i] - plate[i - 1]).max() > 0 for i in range(1, 6)))
    return ([check('frames change only at the 0.1 s step boundaries', changes == exp_changes, changes[:6], exp_changes[:6]), check('0.6 s loop: frame 0 == frame 18', loop == 0, loop, 0), check('grain is desaturated (R == B)', grey == 0, grey, 0), check('vignette darkens the corners', corner < centre * 0.75, [corner, centre], 'corner < .75 centre'), check('negative control: the plate without grain never changes', plate_changes == 0, int(plate_changes), 0)], [vid])

            elif st == 'vignette':
